duration.value: 1 round or until discharged DESCRIPTION You create a rushing torrent of water in the rough outline of a shield. The water protects you from one physical or fire attack, granting you DR/— and fire resistance equal to half your caster level (minimum 1) on that attack. Once the spell has reduced the damage of one attack against you, it is discharged.
